guarantees.claim: valids bits are driven by the .valid fields of aes_key_o, kmac_sideload_key, and otbn_key_o using indices AesIdx, KmacIdx, OtbnIdx.
sideload_sel_err_o is asserted when any bit of (~valid_tracking_q & valids) is high, indicating a sideload key valid outside the allowed window.
kmac_key_o selects key_i when key_i.valid is true, otherwise selects kmac_sideload_key.
prng_en_o is assigned the value of clr, enabling PRNG when clearing.
The module asserts that data_valid_i high implies key_i.valid high in the same cycle.

assumptions.claim: valid_tracking_q correctly indicates the allowed window for sideload key valid signals.
assumptions.risk: False sideload error reporting or missed detection of illegal key valid.

assumptions.claim: key_i.valid accurately reflects when key_i contains a valid internal key.
assumptions.cond: when key_i.valid is used for mux or assertion
assumptions.risk: Incorrect kmac key source selection leading to use of wrong key and potential security breach.

uncertain_points.claim: The parameters AesIdx, KmacIdx, OtbnIdx must be unique to avoid multiple drivers on the same valids bit.
uncertain_points.cond: if any two parameters are equal
uncertain_points.risk: Multiple combinational drivers cause X or conflict in simulation/synthesis.
